request.style: English, male baritone, solo voice, acoustic piano, cello, ambient pads, soft drums, reverent and hopeful, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
By faith we understand the universe formed
By the word of God, not from visible things
Abel offered a better sacrifice
Commended as righteous through his own belief

[Chorus]
Without faith it is impossible to please him
Whoever comes to God must believe he exists
And that he rewards those who seek him
Faith is the key to his love

[Verse]
Enoch was taken up, did not see death
Commended as one who pleased God
Noah built the ark in reverent fear
Heir of the righteousness that comes by faith

[Chorus]
Without faith it is impossible to please him
Whoever comes to God must believe he exists
And that he rewards those who seek him
Faith is the key to his love

[Bridge]
Abraham obeyed when he was called
To go out to a place as inheritance
He went not knowing where he was going
Living as a stranger in the land of promise

[Chorus]
Without faith it is impossible to please him
Whoever comes to God must believe he exists
And that he rewards those who seek him
Faith is the key to his love

[Outro]
Believe he exists and rewards those who seek
Faith pleases God and leads us home
